channel.title: World Business | Global Business News Today
channel.description: Global economy, trade, energy and industrial policy news for business leaders.

item.title: Iran Strikes Bahrain Base Hosting US Forces for Second Time in Three Days
item.description: Iran's IRGC says it fired six drones at Bahrain's Riffa base hosting US forces; Bahrain says it intercepted them. What happened and what it means for oil.

item.title: Middle East Fintech Boom Leaves the Unbanked Behind, Industry Leaders Warn
item.description: Gulf fintech is booming, but account ownership in Egypt, Jordan and Lebanon is below half. Why leaders from Botim and Emirates NBD call it a blind spot.

item.title: Sanctioned Russian Payments Firm A7 Pitches India Rupee and Stablecoin Services
item.description: Russia's A7 pitched India payment services in Mumbai. The US calls the A7 Network a transnational criminal organization. What Indian firms should know.

item.title: Trump Says Dana White Press Secretary Offer Was a Joke as Job Stays Vacant
item.description: Trump offered UFC boss Dana White the press secretary job on Truth Social, then said he was "only kidding". What happened and why the post is vacant.

item.title: Drone Attack Halts Iraq's Khor Mor Gas Field, Leaving 70% of Kurdistan Without Power
item.description: A drone hit Iraq's Khor Mor gas field on Nov 8, halting output and knocking out about 2.8 GW of power in Kurdistan. What happened and what comes next.

item.title: Navy QuickLinks Explained: How to Find MyNavy Portal Quick Links Safely
item.description: Navy Quick Links is the directory of Sailor tools inside MyNavy Portal at mn3p.navy.mil. How to access it with CAC, fix errors and avoid lookalike sites.

item.title: Temporary Identity Certificate (TIC): How to Get One in South Africa and India
item.description: What a temporary identity certificate is, how to get a TIC from Home Affairs in South Africa (R70) and how India's ESIC TIC became the e-Pehchan card.

item.title: USCIS Form I-485 in 2026: Fees, New Edition and Rules That Get Applications Rejected
item.description: Form I-485 costs $1,440 on paper or $1,390 online in 2026. Here is who can file, the new 09/18/26 edition, required documents and costly mistakes.

item.title: Celebrities and Eating Disorders: What Famous Disclosures Reveal About a $64.7 Billion Problem
item.description: From Karen Carpenter to Taylor Swift, celebrity eating disorder disclosures shape awareness. Here is what the research, courts and a $64.7B cost study show.

item.title: Clean Manufacturing Incentives in 2026: How US, EU and Australian Support Is Shifting
item.description: US credits are narrowing, the EU wants Made in EU rules and Australia funds solar supply chains. What manufacturers need to know as energy costs bite.
